scope: Static research publication; no MCP business or execution authority

presentation.description: Physics to archaeology through the pyramids. A connected research corpus on matter, mechanisms, material histories and surviving evidence.
presentation.footer: A living research corpus by Aaron Alderman and contributors. The pyramids invite attention; evidence carries the conclusions.

home.title: Physics to archaeology through the pyramids
home.headline: A pyramid is a meeting of worlds.
home.deck: Electronic states shape bonds. Minerals form stone. People transform materials. Time changes the traces. Follow the missing middles that connect them.
home.note: The Great Pyramid of Khufu is our first anchor. Every monument, material and claim keeps its own identity.
home.imageAlt: Schematic pyramid cutaway showing the connecting layers of material, process, surviving trace and historical inference. It is an illustration, not a reconstruction.
home.orientation: One familiar monument opens a much larger question: how do we connect what matter permits, what people could do, and what the surviving evidence lets us conclude?
home.spineTitle: All the way down. All the way back.
home.spineDescription: Descend from the monument to the physical mechanism. Return through predictions, measurements and preserved traces. Each change of description has to account for what it keeps and what it loses.
home.exampleEyebrow: A REAL DETECTOR TO STRUCTURE BRIDGE
home.exampleTitle: Seeing a corridor is one question. Explaining it is another.
home.exampleDescription: Muon observations characterized a corridor-shaped structure in Khufu’s Pyramid. A geometric record can be strong while questions about construction sequence and function still require different evidence.
home.closingTitle: The interesting work lives between the boxes.
home.closingDescription: Chemistry, geology, geophysics and archaeology overlap. The corpus preserves their connecting mechanisms, assumptions, alternatives and tests so another person can continue the work.
home.workedTitle: Follow the evidence through the middle.
home.workedDescription: Follow material identity, chemical balances, competing histories and variation analysis. Inspect the controls, calculations and bottlenecks that connect a claim to its next useful test.

sections.title: The scientific objects
sections.copy: The existing twelve-coordinate kernel, typed candidate relations, joint inputs, negative constraints and unresolved questions remain explicit. A grammatical connection does not establish a physical or historical claim.

sections.title: The interface is decomposed too
sections.copy: Every generated native page is checked by the retained Sourcery surface-composition and native-lowering mechanisms. Controls come from a declared collection grammar. The prose region is imported Markdown and retains an explicit rendering boundary.

sections.title: The existing mechanisms are retained
sections.copy: This publication reuses the common-algebra interpreter, component library, collection controls, native lowering and static serializer. Source hashes identify the retained bytes and the serializer extraction.

links.label: Read the reuse and authority decisions

sections.title: Composition has an authority ceiling
sections.copy: A record-level path can carry types, assumptions, losses and evidence into a reading projection. The attempted jump from publication to a confirmed ancient process is rejected by the retained composer.

links.label: Inspect the common-algebra composition and refusal

sections.title: Worked evidence and reproducible calculations
sections.copy: The worked layer adds source-scoped assessments, ten conditional or synthetic calculations and atomic research steps using the same twelve-coordinate kernel. The numerical adapter performs formula accounting, contrasts and scenario calculations; the retained composer checks declared quantity-dimension maps. Neither substitutes for a measured rate or historical evidence.

sections.title: Variation analysis in action
sections.copy: The pyramid-centred demonstration carries constrained compositions, nuisance factors, factorial contrasts, sensitivity surfaces and production bottlenecks through the same research-step and calculation records. Synthetic responses and timings supply no experimental or historical authority.
